source_audit.finding: Current runtime models Contribution as spendable balance; this conflicts with ratified economy.

faction_record.merito: safe non-negative integer; separate rank progression

keep_or_adapt.name: otorgarContribucion(cantidad,motivo,id)
keep_or_adapt.new_behavior: increment registro.contribucion exactly once; never touches a spendable balance

keep_or_adapt.name: otorgarMerito(cantidad,motivo,id)
keep_or_adapt.new_behavior: unchanged dimension; return field names updated so no saldo terminology remains

keep_or_adapt.name: rangoFaccion(id)
keep_or_adapt.new_behavior: continues to derive rank from merito unless separately redesigned

keep_or_adapt.name: cmd_contribucion()
keep_or_adapt.new_behavior: pure query displaying cumulative Contribution, merit and rank; no spendable-balance wording

add.name: contribucionFaccion(id)
add.role: single reader for authoritative cumulative Contribution

data_purge.rule: Do not convert these automatically to free services, stone prices or new merchant stock. New offers require explicit new commerce authority.

save_contract.behavior: Schema-2 development saves are rejected/reset; new game initializes clean faction record with contribucion=0.
save_contract.rationale: Version bump prevents an old spendable-balance save from being silently reinterpreted as cumulative Contribution.

arc1_expected_awards.rule: Existing mission reward event remains the grant point; each mission reward may grant Contribution once only.

integration_guards: No code path may decrement registro.contribucion.
No runtime field named saldo may represent Contribution.
No runtime field gastos may exist solely for Contribution spending.
Commerce gates read only through the authoritative Contribution reader.
Old save schema is rejected rather than migrated.

scope.purpose: clean-slate contract for future Astra/ver76 integration
scope.note: Slice1 Ning Cai public item does not require Contribution; this contract can be integrated/validated independently before institutional commerce expansion.

ratification.note: Ratified as clean-slate design authority. Runtime integration remains a separate future step.
